panel.title: Cloud saves
panel.clientWhy: Platypus doesn't sync this game while it is open, because two programs writing the same saves cause conflicts.
panel.clientInstead: Launch it through {{name}} instead, or close {{name}} to sync.
panel.error: Platypus couldn't reach the cloud saves just now.
panel.runningConflict: {{title}} is running. Choose its saves after it exits.

modeHelp.off: Platypus doesn't sync this game's saves.
modeHelp.ask: Syncs on its own when nothing clashes; asks when saves changed on both sides or the store is unreachable.
modeHelp.auto: Like ask, but once you launch anyway while the store is unreachable it stops asking for this game. Conflicts always ask.

setting.description: Whether Platypus syncs each store's save files to its cloud. Each game can override its store's choice on its page.
setting.error: Platypus couldn't save the cloud setting.

conflict.label: Cloud save conflict
conflict.heading: Saves changed on both sides
conflict.intro_one: {{title}} has a save file that changed on this device and in the cloud.
conflict.intro_other: {{title}} has {{count}} save files that changed on this device and in the cloud.
conflict.explanation: Platypus won't overwrite either without your say. Keeping the cloud copy backs up the file on this device first; keeping this device's copy replaces the cloud one.
conflict.error: Platypus couldn't settle these saves. Nothing was changed on either side.

host.openGame: Open the game's page to decide.
host.offlineWhy: You can launch {{title}} anyway. Its saves on this device may be older or newer than the cloud's.

notice.openGame: Open the game page for details
